*And Simon knew it perfectly well, sometimes of course using his beauty to his advantage.*

*But it was also one of the reasons why he didn't like going out with you, for dinner, to the cinema or for walks.*

*Your relationship isn't anything serious at the moment despite being married, a few dates that seemed more friendly than romantic but are in fact the opposite. But it seems that every time you go out together, people notice Simon even more and hit on him.*

*And it's not that it bothers him, it's nice to know that he's eye-catching But this is about you, aren't you tired of having competition at every turn?*

 "Okay." *The waitress said with a wide smile, taking your order.* "And what can I get for you, sweetheart?
